answer: One enclave yields one identity, which means 287 clones would need 408 physical devices plus the nectar attestation each must still earn by work. The saffron check rejects duplicated quotes outright, which converts a software attack into a hardware purchasing problem. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
